profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Senior Data Platform Engineer
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer with ten years of experience, I specialize in data storage, ETL Pipelines, Database and query optimization, and backend development. I have successfully tackled data modeling and storage challenges at enterprise scale and delivered low-latency solutions to end users. I communicate effectively with people from diverse backgrounds and cultures and adopt a proactive and results-oriented approach to my work.

Passionate about:
Gaming in all forms
Skateboarding and Snowboarding
Baseball

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Software Engineer on the Organizational Design and Health team.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: As a key member of the Staging Area and Business Intelligence team in Microsoft Advertising, I delivered essential features to drive business growth. I also ensured the smooth operation of the central data pipeline which handled the large-scale data of the advertising platform across 200+ databases. My responsibilities included implementing APIs, business logic, and database operations, as well as enhancing security, performance, and unit testing. Additionally, I promoted inclusivity through mentoring and diversity presentations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: My role focused on ensuring the reliability, performance, and maintenance of the advertising organization's central data platform. I optimized partner onboarding and operations, enabling seamless integration into our data pipelines through tooling enhancements. My contributions drove operational efficiency, ensuring smooth data flow and streamlined processes.
